notes.title: Son müzik bulmacasının takılma sorununu çözdük!
notes.content:
Bazı oyuncular "Low Quality" seçili olduğunda, oyunun son müzik bulmacasının  takılıp kaldığını bildirdiler, bu hatayı düzelttik.
Oyunu indirip, kaldığınız yerden devam edebilirsiniz.

Bu hatayı bildirip bize yardımcı olan Yasin Azazi'ye çok teşekkürler.

notes.title: Bug fix on final music puzzle
notes.content:
Some players have reported that the game stops at the "Live Music Show" puzzle at the end of the game. It was happening only on "Low quality" settings. 
We have fixed the issue, so you can download and continue playing.

notes.title: Better Navigation system in Beat the Game
notes.content:
We have completely updated our navigation camera system, now we can play with mouse, just like classic point and click adventure or WASD keyboard or game controller like 3rd person character navigation.

it's end up quite cool and unique, now you can either play with mouse only, or keyboard mouse combo in front of you computer. If you feel like keep playing on your couch you can switch to your game controller and go from there.

It is also playable with touch friendly computers, like surface pro.
